01 / About Avenzo

A good PC starts with
a better understanding.

Avenzo makes gaming PCs easier to choose. We help you understand which components suit the way you use your computer, then assemble, configure and test your selected build.

Value comes from balancing the whole system. We explain the choices that matter, so you can spend on useful performance without adding upgrades you don’t need.

New and used, explained

Our PCs combine new parts with carefully selected used components. The breakdown below makes it clear what to expect before you order.

The components / Clear from the start

Know what goes
into your PC.

New cases and cooling, paired with tested used hardware. Here’s how the components are selected.

New

Case, CPU cooler, fans, RGB controller, Wi-Fi adapter and power cable.

Used

Graphics card, RAM, SSD and power supply.

New or used

CPU and motherboard, depending on the selected build and availability.

Established component brands

Power supplies are Corsair, with wattage selected to suit the build. Motherboards are typically Gigabyte; MSI and other established brands may also be used.

Specific requirements?

Exact component brands and models depend on availability unless confirmed for your order. If you need a particular feature, connection or model, ask before ordering.

06 / Working with suppliers

Building lasting
supplier relationships.

Avenzo is an active independent system builder seeking dependable, long-term relationships with UK distributors, wholesalers and component manufacturers.

We help customers choose appropriate systems, present builds professionally and communicate directly throughout the buying process. Testing completed PCs is part of that approach.

  • Trade purchasing arrangements and pricing
  • Reliable component availability
  • Repeat purchasing as the business develops
  • Clear product information and after-sales support

To discuss working together, get in touch with Fin.

07 / Good questions

A little more
clarity.

Can you help me choose a specification?

Yes. Share your budget, games, applications and monitor details. We’ll explain suitable options and help you decide what you need. Get in touch.

Can I choose the case and configuration?

Our case options are Black Dual Chamber Panoramic and White Dual Chamber Panoramic. Check the eBay listing for available configurations, and ask before ordering if you have a specific requirement.

Will I receive the exact components pictured?

Photographs show example builds. Your selected listing defines the specification; exact component brands and models can vary unless agreed for your order. The component breakdown above explains which parts are new or used.

Where do I purchase?

Purchases are completed through Avenzo on eBay, where you’ll find current configurations, prices and availability.

How long will my order take?

Check the delivery estimate on the current eBay listing. If you need a PC for a birthday or another occasion, ask before ordering so we can discuss timing.
